payload.body: Crate CR-108 follow-up: the Rust tenant-switch slice now preserves the TypeScript authenticated-user 60/min limiter locally for PUT /api/me/active-tenant and POST /api/me/switch-tenant. When Crate adopts Frick's trusted client-IP/rate-limit context broadly, include an authenticated-principal key path as well as public client-IP keys so apps do not keep bespoke keyed limiter plumbing.
